verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents an Assistant capability that answers questions about your proprietary data with grounded, cited answers, plus a no-code knowledge app template in public preview, so it does generate AI answers from your data. However, this is on-demand Q&A that a user builds and queries, not proactive insights or suggestions surfaced inside the console. Missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions over stored data, evidence that this works in the console/UI (the console is described only for monitoring and exploring data), GA status for the no-code app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
